description: This file defines the SumSquares class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, containing static methods for calculating sum of squares and related mathematical operations used in spreadsheet calculations.

classes.name: SumSquares
classes.description: Provides static methods for sum of squares calculations and variations used in spreadsheet functions.

methods.name: sumSquare
methods.description: Calculates the sum of the squares of the given arguments.

methods.name: sumXSquaredMinusYSquared
methods.description: Calculates the sum of (x^2 - y^2) for two data matrices.

methods.name: sumXSquaredPlusYSquared
methods.description: Calculates the sum of (x^2 + y^2) for two data matrices.

methods.name: sumXMinusYSquared
methods.description: Calculates the sum of (x - y)^2 for two data matrices.
